package.name: handpose_depth_estimation
package.description: Per-joint 3D hand-pose estimation: pick two of the rig's cameras, triangulate all 21 MediaPipe hand landmarks independently (handpose3d_msgs/HandLandmarks + calibration_multi_cam extrinsics/intrinsics) into the world frame, publish the skeleton for RViz and the 21 joints as PoseArrays, and reproject the result back onto each camera's image_raw for visual QA.
